summary.text: The contractor tender closed on 20 November with two bids. The team had hoped for at least four.

quotes.text: The contractor tender closed on the twentieth of November and we only got two bids, we were hoping for at least four.

summary.text: Procurement accepts two bids as the minimum, so the tender is compliant. Ravi flagged that two bids is a problem for value for money because there are too few prices to compare.

quotes.text: Procurement said two is the minimum they accept, so we're compliant, but it's a problem for value for money.
With only two, you can't really tell where the middle of uh the market is.

summary.text: Kemlite Builders bid 310 thousand and the other bid was 345 thousand. Kemlite is the lower bid.

quotes.text: Kemlite Builders came in at three hundred and ten thousand, the other bid was three hundred and forty five.
Kemlite is the lower one, correct.

summary.text: Jonas asked whether the two bids were priced like for like. Ravi did not answer from memory and said he would want to check the detail. The board ended the item agreeing the field is thin but compliant.

quotes.text: are they like for like?
I'd want to check the detail before I answered that properly.
It's thin, we've said that, and it's compliant, we've said that.

topics.title: End stage report and stage 3 approval

summary.text: The end stage report recommends awarding the contract to Kemlite and moving into stage 3, construction.

quotes.text: The end stage report recommends we award to Kemlite and move into stage three, construction.

summary.text: Wei Ling said the Kemlite design met all the user must-haves, but the higher bid dropped the second meeting room. The board saw this as making the choice clearer.

quotes.text: From the user side the Kemlite design met all our must-haves, the other one dropped the second meeting room.
With only two bids I was worried we were choosing between nothing, but this is a clearer choice.

summary.text: Ravi asked for the value for money concern to stay on record.

quotes.text: I'd still keep the value for money point on record, but it isn't muddying the choice.

summary.text: The board approved stage 3 and the award to Kemlite Builders at 310 thousand. Jonas and Wei Ling agreed.

quotes.text: the board approves stage three and the award to Kemlite Builders at three hundred and ten thousand.
Agreed from me.
Agreed, Agreed, yes.

actions.text: Issue the letter of award to Kemlite Builders.

quotes.text: Thanks, I'll issue the letter of award tomorrow.

summary.text: The workstation supplier now quotes a 10-week lead time instead of 6. This came in after the pack went out, so it is not in the report. No reason for the change was given.

quotes.text: The workstation supplier is quoting ten weeks lead time now, sort of it used to be six.
It came through to me, I think, after the pack went out, so it's not in the report.
I don't have a uh reason to give you.

summary.text: If the 10 weeks holds, there is a real chance the desks arrive after the move-in date. The board agreed this is a real chance but not certain.

quotes.text: If that holds, there's a real chance the desks arrive after the move-in date.
It's a real chance, it isn't certain.

summary.text: The standard desks could be ordered now, with only the meeting room tables ordered later. The meeting room tables depend on the second meeting room that was just approved.

quotes.text: We can order the standard desks now and only sort of the meeting room tables later.
the second meeting room is part of what we've just approved. So that piece is the one still being worked through.

summary.text: No decision was made on ordering the desks early. Grace wanted to hear more first, and Wei Ling noted it is a board question.

quotes.text: I don't want to rush into a decision on it here, I'd rather hear I mean a bit more first.
I'd like us to use it, given the lead time, but I know it's a board question.

actions.text: Forward the workstation supplier's quote to Ravi so the 10-week lead time is in writing.

quotes.text: Way Ling, could you send me the quote, so I have the sort of ten weeks in writing?
Yes, Yes, I can do that. I'll forward it, it's in my inbox.

summary.text: The January network install needs the central IT team, who are also committed to another project that month. Jonas has not seen their plan, so he could not say how firm that commitment is.

quotes.text: The network install in January needs the central IT team, and uh they're also committed to another project that month.
I haven't seen their plan, so I can't tell you how firm it is.

summary.text: The install can only happen if central IT gives the team both the second and third weeks of January. This has been discussed with central IT but nothing is agreed.

quotes.text: our install can kind of only happen if central IT gives us the second and third week of January.
We've talked to them, but nothing's been agreed.

summary.text: It is not known whether the other project overlaps those weeks fully or only partly.

quotes.text: I can't say whether it overlaps exactly or only partly.

summary.text: Grace will raise it with the IT director.

quotes.text: On IT, the need is clear and I'll take it to the IT director on Thursday.

actions.text: Raise the need for central IT in the second and third weeks of January with the IT director at the leadership meeting.

quotes.text: I'll raise it with the IT director at the leadership meeting on Thursday.

summary.text: The schedule is built on the landlord having approved the works by 13 December.

quotes.text: Our schedule is built on the landlord approving the works by the thirteenth of December.
Approved by the thirteenth.

summary.text: The landlord has been asked but has not replied, so the team keeps assuming 13 December.

quotes.text: They haven't said no, they just haven't replied, so for now we kind of keep assuming the thirteenth.
They've been asked. It's with uh them. They haven't come back.

summary.text: Ravi and Jonas declined to speculate on what a different date would mean.

quotes.text: I'm not going to describe what happens if it moves, because like I'd be making it up.

summary.text: The board agreed to keep working to 13 December and keep chasing the landlord.

quotes.text: On the landlord, we keep going on the thirteenth and keep chasing.

actions.text: Keep chasing the landlord for approval and tell Grace early if it slips.

quotes.text: Okay, keep chasing them, and tell me early if it slips.
Understood.
